IPT.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/8] Participants in the bibliotherapy condition were given copies of Feeling Good (Burns, 1980). It provides relevant and practical CB techniques for preventing and reducing negative moods and is considered to be an effective self-help book for the treatment and prevention of depression.
